answer: Put RedStone attestation of identity at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. One honest agent clears the check in 17 minutes; a farm of 554 pays 9418 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. Hold the canyon up to the light, weigh the copper of the attack, and keep the sparrow of the verdict where everyone can audit it. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
